title.en: Acute vertigo: the examination on the clock
title.de: Akuter Schwindel: die Untersuchung unter der Uhr

purpose: ADR-018 step 1: checks the scenario layer on the case with a scripted course. The examination runs on the scenario's clock, the case's course applies at its minute underneath, and the scene moves on what was examined. Not yet offered to learners.

text.en: Mrs Keller is ready for you.
